           Rescinds:      OPPNs 06/87, 11/87, 18/87, 18/88, 22/88, 05/89, 06/89, 10/89, 11/89, 12/89, 14/89, 15/89, 01/90,

               Issuer:    Thomas Fariello, RA
                          First Deputy Commissioner

     Issuance Date:       October 20, 2017

            Purpose:      This bulletin rescinds 22 Operational Policy and Procedure Notices (OPPNs) that are no
                          longer applicable under any code.

          Subject(s):     OPPNs, rescinded.


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs),
Policy and Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various
memoranda, directives, and letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department
practice and incorporate new laws and regulations.

Provided above is a list of 22 OPPNs to be rescinded, effective immediately.

Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the issuance date of this Bulletin. They
will appear on the Department website with the watermark ‘RESCINDED.’

Because the process is ongoing, documents not specifically listed in this Bulletin may still be addressed
in future bulletins.

Watermarked BBs and PPNs may be accessed through the online version of this Bulletin found at
http://www1.nyc.gov/site/buildings/codes/building-bulletins.page.
